context.conventions: REST or GraphQL API, middleware pattern, controller-service-repository layers

developer.extra_instructions: Use async/await for all async operations. Validate all inputs at API boundaries. Use proper HTTP status codes. Follow existing middleware patterns.

tester.extra_instructions: Use supertest for API endpoint testing. Mock database and external services. Test both success and error paths for every endpoint.

security.extra_instructions: Check for SQL/NoSQL injection in query construction. Verify rate limiting on auth endpoints. Check CORS configuration. Validate JWT handling.
